---
name: Experiment
about: Test a hypothesis with an outcome that is not known in advance
title: "[Experiment] "
---

## Research question
What question should this experiment answer?

## Goal
What decision or understanding should this experiment support?

## Hypothesis
What do you expect to happen, and why? It is acceptable for the results not to
support this hypothesis.

## Baseline and comparison
What existing method or result will this be compared against? What is the
control condition?

## Variable under test
What single change or factor is being tested? List other settings that should
remain fixed.

## Data and protocol
Identify the dataset or sample, inclusion criteria, split strategy, and
procedure. Note steps needed to avoid data leakage.

## Plan
List the steps for running the experiment.
- Describe an experiment step.

## Out of scope
List analyses or changes this experiment will not cover.
- Describe an excluded analysis or change.

## Evaluation
Name the primary metric and any secondary metrics. Define how results will be
interpreted without assuming the hypothesis is true.

## Reproducibility
Record the code/configuration, random seed (if applicable), and command needed
to run the experiment.

## Planning model
Name the AI tool/agent and model used to plan this experiment, or write "None."

## Planning chat
Link the planning conversation, or summarize the key prompts and decisions.

## Results
After running the experiment, record settings, measured results, and the
conclusion. Include negative or inconclusive results.

## Completion criteria
- [ ] The agreed protocol was run and its configuration is recorded.
- [ ] Results are reported, including negative or inconclusive results.
- [ ] The conclusion and any follow-up questions are documented.
